scope: Local durable lifecycle around the retained public native/authenticated service; the source-scale Q76.3b gate follows separately
arithmetic: Reuse isolated ABI1202 library and all 16 retained Q74 owner canonical N16/N32 cases; no new HE keys, encryption, decryption, CUDA port or timing panel
authentication: Standard ephemeral Ed25519 test/cohort keys; public owner anchor fixed by trusted caller; authentication secrets never serialized
storage: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, rollback journal and synchronous FULL; trusted local filesystem, correct locking/flush semantics and no database rollback/cloning are explicit assumptions

state_machine.activation: Authenticated enrollment installs initial snapshot; exact same snapshot/epoch is idempotent, replacement requires strictly increasing UInt64 epoch
state_machine.reservation: Authenticate original query and bind nonce before seed/native admission; consume nonce globally within this owner/scope journal, including a valid signed stale-context or malformed-seed attempt
state_machine.admission: Only complete public native arithmetic/frame acceptance can authorize; current snapshot is rechecked in the authorization transaction
state_machine.dispatch: Verify the stored authorization and complete frame, recheck snapshot, durably claim callback before calling it; snapshot replacement after this commit is ordered after dispatch
state_machine.failure: Rejected, crashed, or callback-failed attempts are never reset; crash can lose delivery
state_machine.contract: At most one authorization and callback claim per consumed nonce; no exactly-once delivery

interfaces: Public authorizer has no callback or HE secret; separate trusted local callback guard returns no callback value and exposes only a generic local failure. This is not a signed/attested remote client-release protocol
required_gates: All 16 retained authenticated flows and complete frames accepted before public test hooks
Bad full body/frame/context/type/grammar denies; valid request nonce stays consumed
Bad owner signature cannot consume another owner's request identity or begin native work
Late malformed signed seed consumes the valid authenticated nonce before native work
Same/different-query nonce replay, cross-snapshot reuse, duplicate dispatch and forged local authorization deny
Thread and independent spawned-process races admit/dispatch at most once
Restart and actual child os._exit after reservation or callback claim preserve consumption
Snapshot replacement before authorization/dispatch rejects; replacement after dispatch commit is ordered later
UInt64 maximum epoch/IDs, wrong owner/scope/policy, database errors and closed/inherited process ownership fail closed
Callbacks cannot approve arithmetic; callback values/errors are not returned through public admission
No production source/library/main/staging changes; frozen source/library/evidence receipts
